missing_hlg_evaluation.rationale: The current High-Level Goals for the Farmer actor comprehensively cover the functional responsibilities described in the project documentation. 'Provide product availability and details' covers the initial estimation phase (Friday/Saturday). 'Confirm actual product quantities' covers the confirmation phase (Monday morning) which triggers order processing. 'Ensure timely product delivery to the store' covers the physical delivery phase (Tuesday evening). There are no other distinct functional intentions or responsibilities assigned to the Farmer in the description that are not already captured by these broad goals. The consequences of late delivery (SMS reminders, order updates, refunds) are handled by the system and Store Employees (covered by 'Verify farmer deliveries'), not by the Farmer directly.
